programme.title: Fujian's Tulou - The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.A tulou is not only a safe..

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special "reunion dinner" on the eve of the Torch Festival - just like their own New Year's Eve feast...

programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.sub-title: K1 World Grand Prix: Final 14, Osaka, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final Elimination was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Osaka Dome in Osaka, Japan on Saturday, October 11, 2003 in front of 31,700 spectators. It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The fourteen fighters were a mixture of invitees or had qualified via previous events.

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: K1 World Grand Prix: Finals, Tokyo, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Het land waar ooit een held leefde
programme.desc: Sakura gaat met Tazuna de stad in en ziet de ontberingen die de mensen van het Land van de golven lijden onder het bewind van Gato. Dit is de reden dat Tazuna zijn leven op het spel zet om een ​​brug over de oceaan te bouwen. Met een brug die iedereen toegang geeft tot andere landen, zijn mensen niet langer afhankelijk van Gato, die alle invoer controleert.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Strijd op de brug! Zabuza keert terug!
programme.desc: Terwijl Naruto zich concentreert op de training om zijn chakra te beheersen, verschijnt er plotseling een mysterieus persoon voor hem. De persoon vertelt Naruto dat zolang iemand het verlangen heeft om te beschermen waar hij van houdt, er geen limiet is om sterker te worden. De mysterieuze figuur weerspiegelt het sentiment in Naruto en de twee voelen een gevoel van verbondenheid.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Haku's geheime jutsu: kristallen ijsspiegels
programme.desc: Opnieuw is het tijd om tegen Zabuza te vechten, en deze keer heeft hij gezelschap: de speurende ninja die hem zogenaamd heeft vermoord. Zabuza en zijn metgezel nemen kennis van Sasuke's capaciteiten, en Sasuke realiseert zich op zijn beurt de enorme kracht die de gemaskerde ninja bezit. Alsof het de bedoeling was dat ze met elkaar zouden vechten, beginnen Sasuke en de gemaskerde ninja te vechten.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De hyperactieve nummer één, Knucklehead Ninja, voegt zich bij de strijd
programme.desc: Sasuke komt in de knel binnenin Haku's Crystal Ice Mirrors, maar Naruto schiet te hulp. Maar Sasuke heeft een plan om Haku's jutsu tegen te gaan met aanvallen van zowel binnen als buiten de Crystal Ice Mirrors, en Naruto's onverwachte actie verpest Sasuke's strategie. Uiteindelijk zitten beide jonge ninja's in de val.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Nul zichtbaarheid: de Sharingan verbrijzelt
programme.desc: Kakashi beseft dat de tijd dringt en besluit de Sharingan opnieuw te gebruiken om Zabuza te verslaan.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto en Sasuke blijven aanvallen ontvangen vanuit Haku's Crystal Ice Mirrors. Naruto kan niet meer op zijn benen staan. Maar tijdens het intense gevecht begint Sasuke de kracht van zijn eigen Sharingan te beseffen en begint geleidelijk aan Haku's aanvallen te ontlopen.Haku besluit hen onmiddellijk af te maken. Sasuke wordt verrast door Haku's actie en gebruikt zijn eigen lichaam om Naruto te beschermen..

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto explodeert eindelijk. Zijn woede tegen Haku, die Sasuke versloeg, ontketent de kracht van de Kyûbi. Naruto's chakra wordt zo intens dat zelfs Kakashi en Zabuza, die in de verte vechten, het opmerken. Haku kan niets uitrichten tegenover Naruto's verborgen kracht.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Het wapen bekend als Shinob
programme.desc: Haku zegt tegen de aarzelende Naruto dat hij hem moet afmaken. Naruto zet grote vraagtekens bij Haku's filosofie dat hij alleen bestaat om te vechten en te winnen. Ondertussen nadert het gevecht tussen Kakashi en Zabuza zijn hoogtepunt. Zabuza's beweging wordt beperkt door Kakashi's Summoning Jutsu. Met de overwinning binnen handbereik ontketent Kakashi zijn meest verwoestende manoeuvre.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De Demon in de sneeuw
programme.desc: Zabuza is niet langer Kakashi's vijand en dankzij een kleine toespraak van Naruto over hoe ninja's zijn, neemt Zabuza het in zijn eentje op tegen Gato's mannen. De Demon van de Verborgen Mist neemt wraak op Gato en iedereen die dom genoeg is om hem te volgen. Nadat de groep heeft afgerekend met de rest van Gato's mannen, vraagt Zabuza aan Kakashi een laatste verzoek, om Haku nog één keer te zien. Dit is Zabuza's requiem.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Een nieuw hoofdstuk begint: het Chunin-examen
programme.desc: Nu hun laatste missie is voltooid, is het weer tijd voor de groep om terug te gaan naar middelmatige missies. Nadat ze allemaal klaar zijn, brengen Konohamaru en zijn vrienden een bezoek aan Naruto. Wat resulteert in een achtervolging door Sakura. Het is echter snel voorbij, want twee mysterieuze ninja's versperren hen de weg en een van hen is niet al te blij met Konohamaru. Sasuke arriveert om de boel te redden, maar de leider van de groep duikt op, met sluipvaardigheden die zelfs Sasuke verbazen. Ondertussen kondigt de Derde Hokage aan dat het weer tijd is voor de Chuunin selectie-examens.

programme.title: De Wereld Op Je Bord
programme.desc: China - Wokken is populair, maar het vraagt behalve een hevig vuur, ook kennis van de zogenaamde woktechniek. Maar hoe doe je dat nu precies? Hanne probeert in deze aflevering van De wereld op je bord het zelf uit . Ze schotelt jullie samen met chefkok Chuck heerlijke garnalen in de wok voor, op z'n Chinees! Met vijfkruidenpoeder.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Varken
programme.desc: In deze aflevering gaat Johan Segers langs bij de beenhouwerij van Benny om er alle geheimen van een goed stuk spek te achterhalen. Zo komt Johan te weten welke verschillende soorten spek er bestaan en voor welke bereiding je ze best kan gebruiken. Slager Benny haalt speciaal voor onze chef een varkensbuikje boven, zet er zijn slagersmes in en zorgt ervoor dat de chef een prachtige blok spek mee naar huis neemt. En daarmee maakt Johan een overheerlijke pasta met spekjes.

programme.title: Bal National
programme.desc: Aflevering 1 - In deze aflevering van Bal National verklapt Wim een slagersgeheim. Hij maalt gemengd gehakt en rolt er balletjes van die garen in een zijdezachte tomatensaus. Zo zet de chef dé ultieme Belgische balletjes-klassieker op de tafel. Vervolgens kwam de inspiratie uit Italië. Wim vult gehaktballen met Parmezaanse kaas en erwtjes en serveert ze met een simpele tomatensaus en spaghetti.

programme.title: De Zomertafel
programme.desc: Aflevering 2 - Dagny Ros & Peppe maken zomerse gerechten. Dagny Ros: Blini's met gerookte zalm en mierikswortel // Gevulde Kipfiletrolletjes // Pastasalade à la Dagny Ros. Peppe: Focaccia op de BBQ // Veggie pasta met een saus van mascarpone en erwtjes // Salade van calamares, octopus & vongole.

programme.title: Snel, Makkelijk & Lekker
programme.desc: Mounir Toub gaat voor meer veggie op ons weekmenu. Daarvoor steekt hij met plezier de handen uit de mouwen met zelfgemaakt flatbread, tomatenhummus en courgettes. Homemade flatbread met toppings, het kan dus Snel, Makkelijk & Lekker.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Lynn, Tess en Maud gaan op zoek naar de culinaire hotspots in Antwerpen. Op het menu: een rock 'n roll beenhouwer, een stokoud, geel drankje en een waar deco paradijs. Inspiratie genoeg voor de meiden om daarna zelf aan de slag te gaan.

programme.title: Toasted
programme.desc: Egg-Starters / Roast Beef Wrapper / Geitenbreier - 's Morgens eten als een koning. Met deze zin brainwasht elke ouder zijn kind. En terecht: ontbijten ís belangrijk, maar ook plezant en ontspannend en dat laatste zit 'm vooral in het bereiden ervan. Het topduo Dagny Ros Asmundsdottir en Dominique Persoone bewijzen dat met heel hun lijf, al hun verhalen en brouwsels in het nieuwe ontbijt&brunchprogramma Toasted!. In deze aflevering maakt de IJslandse schone Dagny Ros haar fameuze Roast Beef Wrapper en zet Dominique iedereen in vuur en vlam met zijn Geitenbreier. Onder het motto "A tikkeneike a day, keeps the doctor away.

programme.title: De Smaaktoerist
programme.desc: In het Hageland vind je heerlijke streekproducten. Dat weet ook Smaaktoerist Jeroen. Denk maar aan de pensen van Vangramberen en de pikante saus van Hilko. De perfecte ingrediënten voor streetfood. En: nog lekkerder met bier uit Bierbeek.

programme.title: Lekker Messy
programme.desc: Messy hotdogs & pasta vongole met mosselen - De broers Beeckman starten hun eerste vakantiedag aan de barbecue voor messy hotdogs. En dat spatje saus op hun t-shirt nemen ze er met plezier bij. 's Avonds genieten Jelle en Hans nog van een smeuïge pasta vongole met mosselen.

programme.title: De Dagschotel
programme.desc: In ‘De Dagschotel’ maakt één van de njam-chefs een eenvoudig en lekker gerecht klaar dat de kijker thuis gemakkelijk kan namaken.

programme.title: Peppe's Sicilië
programme.desc: Peppe's tafelgast vandaag is Gerlando. Hij is de beste vriend van zijn vader, een geweldige kok en vooral: verliefd op de zee... Als hij niet in de keuken staat, vind je hem met zijn voeten in het water. Ook Peppe trekt zijn kaplaarzen aan en gaat met Gerlando op zoek naar mosselen en zee-egels. De oogst van de dag komt terecht in een bordje met verse spaghetti en wordt eervol genuttigd onder de Siciliaanse zon, met een glaasje wijn erbij. De rijkdom van eenvoud.

programme.title: De Garde van Gert
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst rock-'n-rolt vandaag in de keuken met Dominique Persoone. De chef is in een zoete bui en bakt amandelsigaren. Die doopt hij in warme honing, en maakt er een sausje met zwarte olijven bij. Zoet eetplezier gegarandeerd.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Varken
programme.desc: Pitabroodjes zijn hip en dat heeft ook Johan Segers goed begrepen. Op zijn menu van vandaag staat een originele variant op de traditionele pita, die oorspronkelijk met lamsvlees wordt opgevuld. Uiteraard kiest onze chef voor sappige reepjes varkensvlees, die hij -hoe kan het ook anders- bij slager Benny gaat halen. Met de wokpan in de hand tovert Johan een overheerlijk pitabrood op tafel, dat hij opvult met varkensvlees en groentjes uit de wok. Als kers op de taart nog een zelfgemaakt looksausje erbij en smullen maar.

programme.title: De Smaaktoerist
programme.desc: In het Hageland vind je heerlijke streekproducten. Dat weet ook Smaaktoerist Jeroen. Denk maar aan de pensen van Vangramberen en de pikante saus van Hilko. De perfecte ingrediënten voor streetfood. En: nog lekkerder met bier uit Bierbeek.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: Caernarfon - In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris "Flamebaster" in de rijke culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Hij ontdekt de vergeten oestercultuur van de Menai Strait, kookt een klassieke Victoriaanse beef & oyster pie, en serveert sappige brisket buns aan de band Doniau Cudd. Ook bezoekt hij een duurzame paddenstoelenboerderij en proeft hij fine dining bij restaurant Sheeps and Leeks. De aflevering eindigt met een visfeest op zijn oude woonwijk, met vers gevangen makreel van lokale vissers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: A King and His Queen S2 E26
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.desc: Shari and Erol find the perfect California home to raise Shari's two young daughters. When they discover a secret room hidden inside their garage, it triggers a ghostly presence. Now, Shari knows she must do something to protect her daughters.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Soon after moving into an older home in a quaint suburb of Cincinnati, Taylor Jones catches her mother practicing black magic in her daughter Isabelle's bedroom. Her fears become reality when Taylor notices Isabelle playing with an invisible friend.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Anita and her son encounter the ghost of their recently deceased friend while preparing his house to be sold.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Kim and Craig move into their dream home in rural Iowa with Kim's two young daughters. When an unseen entity attacks the family, Kim and Craig realize they could be dealing with a ghost. They turn to a demonologist to help them reclaim the house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On a visit to an exhibit of ancient Egyptian artifacts, Caleb experiences a chilling encounter with a mummy.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy have found the perfect retreat in Alaska for their family. But after their daughter begins to experiment in witchcraft, she unknowingly attracts the attention of a dark entity. Harold calls in experts to help reclaim the home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Angela, a newlywed, is excited to start her new life with Stephen when nightmares that she experienced as a child suddenly resurface. Soon, the menacing old hag from her dreams terrorizes her daughter and takes temporary possession of her son.

programme.title: Out Of Time
programme.desc: Denzel Washington spiller hovedrollen i denne fengslende thrilleren om politisjefen i en småby som havner i klisteret når han etterforsker drapet på kvinnen han hadde en affære med... Fordi alle bevisene peker mot ham.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: En av Terence Hill og Bud Spencers aller største suksesser – og det sier ikke lite. De to første ”Trinity”-filmene var kjempe-suksesser! Samme produsent; Roberto Palaggi, slår her til med en ny hardtslående komedie. Denne gangen er brødrene i Afrika, som guider på løvesafari.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Bud Spencer er Banana Joe, en vennlig kjempe av en banandyrker som bor i en liten Søramerikansk by. Det går livet sin vante gang helt til et stort selskap vil ta over bananplantasjen og sette Joe i fengsel.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Vi befinner oss tidlig på 1600-tallet i føydaltidens Japan, og en mann til hest kjemper mot en gruppe samuraier for så å bli tatt til fange.

programme.title: Supercool
programme.desc: Bestekompisene Neil (Jake Short) og Gilbert (Miles J. Harvey) er lei av å være tapere. De drømmer om å ha det samme livet som naboen Jimmy (Damon Wayans Jr.) som velter seg i raske biler og ville fester.

programme.title: Conan The Barbarian
programme.desc: Det som fra først var den kampglade kimmeriske krigerens hevntokt blir snart en storslagen strid mot digre dødsfiender, uhyrlige udyr og ytterst små sjanser, og Conan innser at bare han kan redde Hyborias herlige hjemland fra de onde angrepene til overnaturlige undertrykkere.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Et ungt par er truet på livet av en ekstremistisk milits og må flykte fra sin misjonsstasjon i Kalahariørkenen. Men når flyet deres styrter i et dyrereservat, må de kjempe mot både mennesker og villdyr for å overleve.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Jake Green har bestandig hengt i eksepsjonelt dårlig selskap. Han er profesjonell spillehai, og en kveld blir han invitert med i et pokerlag med gangsteren Macha.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. In short, this series offers the most flavorful insight into ancient Chinese culture that you are ever going to get.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: The Spirit of Wuhan
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive at Wuhan, the River City known as the "Thoroughfare of Nine Provinces". We take the audience to visit the time‑honoured Yellow Crane Tower, the time‑defying Zhiyin Hao, and the romantic, nostalgic Lihuangpi Road. We listen to well‑loved excerpts from classic Chu Opera and sample authentic local delicacies. Through these small moments, we showcase Wuhan's unique cultural charm and local features.

programme.title: Fujian's Tulou - The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special "reunion dinner" on the eve of the Torch Festival - just like their own New Year's Eve feast...

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final Elimination was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Osaka Dome in Osaka, Japan on Saturday, October 11, 2003 in front of 31,700 spectators. It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The fourteen fighters were a mixture of invitees or had qualified via previous events.

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: K1 World Grand Prix: Finals, Tokyo, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels (Pilot)
programme.desc: Three sexy police-trained detectives work for an unseen boss named, Charlie, who always relays his assignments by telephone.

programme.title: Hellride
programme.desc: "Charlie's Angels," three bright, beautiful, athletic and police-trained private detectives become involved in a whirlwind of danger when they invest-igate the death of a woman stock car racer in the premiere episode of the new detective-drama series, "Charlie's Angels." Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and-Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant. In "Hellride," Sabrina becomes a race driver while Kelly, Jill and Bosley assume unusual disguises to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.

programme.title: The Mexican Connection
programme.desc: Jill, Kelly and Sabrina find themselves in the middle of a syndicate heroin war as "The Mexican Connection" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying cache of heroin. They travel south of the border to Mexico; their mission known only to the lone-surviving pilot of the ill-fated flight. Before they can sake their false identities credible, Charlie's Angels find themselves caught be-tween two warring heroin dealers. Finally, they are able to maneuver one of the drug kingpins into a federal police trap -- only to discover that the other one was working with them all along, under a false identity of his own! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smyth star as the Angels Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler" on "Charlie's Angels." A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels in Chains
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as "Angels in Chains" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a "kangaroo court" to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an "early release" and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Target: Angels
programme.desc: Multiple attempts to kill Kelly, Jill and Sabrina force them to flee to the safety of Charlie's mansion in "Target Angels" on the new series "Charlie's Angels." In separate incidents, an unknown assassin tries to kill Angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina. The pressure intensifies, forcing the girls to take to the only sure safety they know the compound where Charlie lives. Their anticipation at the prospect of seeing Charlie for the first time dims when they suddenly realize they have led the killers to their real target - Charlie! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Killing Kind
programme.desc: Charlie calls angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina together and tells them of the murder of the daughter of an old friend -- a young investigative reporter. In their quest to solve the killing, the three (Jill posing as a magazine photographer, Sabrina as a tennis instructor and Kelly as a guest) penetrate an exclusive hotel-resort. They soon learn that the owner, an underworld figure who, after turn-ing state's evidence and getting a new identity as part of the government's "witness relocation" program, has built a new criminal empire for himself. Their second discovery is that he intends to kill them. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc:
Sabine hat ihr Abitur nicht bestanden und will sich vom Turm einer Brauerei stürzen.

Ihre Freunde Ingo und Roland wollen sie aufhalten. Roland versucht, sie von der Brüstung zu ziehen, und stürzt dabei ab. Bewusstlos hängt er nun auf halber Höhe des Turms an einem Feuerwehrschlauch.

Sabine bleibt unterdessen mit dem Fahrstuhl stecken. Als Ingo ihr helfen will, stürzt er in den Fahrstuhlschacht und bleibt bewusstlos auf dem Aufzugsdach liegen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc:
Die Medicopter-Crew birgt einen bewusstlosen Jungen im Wald. Sie finden bei ihm ein blutiges Handtuch, das sie auf die Spur der Privatklinik von Dr. Schreiber bringt.

Gina und Marc fahren zu der Klinik und kommen nach und nach hinter die kriminellen Methoden des Dr. Schreiber. Der Arzt lässt gezielt Menschen kidnappen und verkauft ihre Organe an seine betuchte Kundschaft.

Bei ihren Ermittlungen geraten Gina und Marc in große Gefahr. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc:
Der geistig verwirrte Ludwig Reiter macht den Arzt Dr. Selb für den Tod seines Sohnes Fabian verantwortlich.

Aus Rache entführt er die vier Kinder von Dr. Selb, den er zwingt, auf einer Bombe zu sitzen, die explodiert, sobald er aufsteht.

Reiter sperrt die Kinder in einer alten Fabrik ein und begeht Selbstmord.

Die Medicopter-Crew macht sich fieberhaft auf die Suche nach den vermissten Kindern. Ein Rätsel soll sie auf ihre Spur führen. (Senderinfo).

Midden in Rotterdam ligt een eiland waar eb en vloed nog altijd het landschap bepalen. Voor muzikant Matthijs is de bijzondere natuur een bron van inspiratie. programme.title: Art Department
programme.desc: De Friese zangeres Clasine Haringsma, die muziek maakt onder de naam Immen, zoekt naar haar plek in een wereld waarin zichtbaarheid als muzikant steeds belangrijker lijkt te worden. In de natuur vindt ze rust en ruimte om terug te keren naar de kern van muziek: het schrijven van nieuwe liedjes, terwijl ze worstelt met het optreden op het podium en verlangt naar de vanzelfsprekendheid waarmee vogels hun koers lijken te kennen.

programme.title: Art Dept
programme.desc: In het Westland, waar glazen kassen de horizon bepalen, nemen een kunstenaar, kweker, druiventeler en gids je mee door het ritme en de symmetrie van de grootste glastuinbouwregio van Nederland. programme.title: MAX maakt mogelijk
programme.desc: In Almelo ontmoet Jan Slagter de lokale held Pappy Pieternella (73), die iedere dag op de fiets stapt om levensmiddelen rond te brengen bij mensen die het niet breed hebben. Jan zet deze supervrijwilliger nu eens zelf in het zonnetje en brengt hem een grote verrassing. MAX Maakt Mogelijk doneert duizend aggregaten aan families die zonder stroom zitten. Deze komen extra goed van pas met de winter in aantocht.

programme.desc: Met het laatste nieuws en de weersverwachting.

programme.title: Stand van Nederland
programme.desc: Het gebruik van datingapps is nog steeds groot. Toch willen steeds meer singles elkaar juist in het echt ontmoeten. En de markt speelt daar slim op in: van spelletjesavonden voor singles tot exclusieve matchmakers. Maar wie heeft daar echt belang bij: jij of zij? In het eerste deel van dit tweeluik legt relatieonderzoeker Janneke Schokkenbroek uit hoe datingapps werken. Statisticus Daniel Oberski vertelt waarom er zo weinig cijfers over daten bekend zijn.

programme.title: De ongelooflijke podcast
programme.sub-title: Filosoof Beeckman: Geloven we nog in de toekomst?
programme.desc: Geloof jij nog in een betere toekomst? Vooruitgang leek jarenlang vanzelfsprekend, maar dat vertrouwen heeft plaatsgemaakt voor onzekerheid. Filosoof Tinneke Beeckman, auteur van Neem de tijd, onderzocht hoe dat komt. Van het optimisme van de jaren negentig tot de politiek van Donald Trump: hoe bepalen onze toekomstbeelden ons leven van vandaag? En hoe vinden we houvast zonder ons vast te klampen aan het verleden?

programme.title: 2 meter sessies
programme.desc: Nieuwe sessie met Coach Party. In september 2025 verscheen Caramel, het tweede album van deze Britse gitaarband. De groep uit Isle of Wight bouwde sinds de oprichting in 2019 een sterke reputatie op met compacte nummers vol rauwe gitaarlijnen en meeslepende melodieën, in de geest van The Pixies en Wolf Alice. Na het succesvolle debuut Killjoy uit 2023 laat Caramel een volwassener geluid horen, zonder de kenmerkende energie te verliezen. In de sessie speelt de band werk van het nieuwe album en gaat in gesprek met presentator Jan Douwe Kroeske.

programme.title: Nu te Zien!
programme.desc: Nu te zien! bestaat tien jaar en daarom verkent Marc de Beyer, directeur van Teylers Museum, eenmalig de interactieve tentoonstelling Zeker weten? in zijn eigen museum in Haarlem. Met behulp van onder meer een bonte verzameling boeken en historische instrumenten laat de tentoonstelling zien dat vragen stellen, twijfelen en creatief denken de basis vormen van betrouwbare wetenschappelijke kennis en vooruitgang.

programme.title: Art Dept
programme.desc: De Friese zangeres Clasine Haringsma, die muziek maakt onder de naam Immen, zoekt naar haar plek in een wereld waarin zichtbaarheid als muzikant steeds belangrijker lijkt te worden. In de natuur vindt ze rust en ruimte om terug te keren naar de kern van muziek: het schrijven van nieuwe liedjes, terwijl ze worstelt met het optreden op het podium en verlangt naar de vanzelfsprekendheid waarmee vogels hun koers lijken te kennen.

programme.title: Art Dept
programme.desc: In het Westland, waar glazen kassen de horizon bepalen, nemen een kunstenaar, kweker, druiventeler en gids je mee door het ritme en de symmetrie van de grootste glastuinbouwregio van Nederland. Centraal staat een schilder die al haar hele leven kassen schildert en gefascineerd is door het lijnenspel en het roze licht. Een ritmisch portret van een hardwerkende streek waar het leven wordt gedomineerd door structuren van glas.

programme.title: Expeditie Nederland
programme.desc: Met pensioen gaan; sommige mensen tellen de dagen af, anderen vinden hun werk nog veel te leuk om te stoppen of gooien het roer zelfs helemaal om. De Friese Oene begon na zijn pensioen een eigen bedrijf. Met zijn passie voor motorrijden organiseert hij reizen door heel Europa, speciaal voor andere pensionado's. Ook de 80-jarige Carlo uit Roosendaal denkt nog niet aan stoppen. Al zestig jaar werkt hij bij dezelfde opticien. En nog steeds gaat hij iedere dag met plezier naar zijn werk.

programme.title: Binnenstebuiten
programme.desc: Gert en Gera wonen in een oude kleuterschool in Tiel. Na een enorm klusproject hebben ze het huis helemaal naar hun wens gemaakt. Naast het huis upgraden, doen ze ook hun best om hun Tiel mooier te maken. Zo is Gera actief bij de vlindertuin en Gert ontwierp een muurschildering over de geschiedenis van Tiel. * Chef-kok Ramon maakt een winterse groentestoof met spek, worst en linzen en serveert er zelfgemaakte aardappelpuree bij. * In de herfst schieten de paddenstoelen uit de grond, ook in de Schoorlse duinen. Boswachter Marieke is met vrijwilliger en paddenstoelenkenner Joop op zoek naar bijzondere en mooie exemplaren.

De andere Varenburgers schieten meteen in de stress bij de gedachte drie uur lang Krijtstra's getrommel en vals gezang te moeten aanhoren. Daan heeft een oplossing: oordoppen. Meneer Fossiel en mevrouw Jura hebben als buren ook last van Krijtstra's repetitie en lopen de hele dag met hun oordoppen rond. Helaas horen ze behalve Krijtstra's gekrijs hun huisdieren ook niet meer.

programme.sub-title: Het geheim van de mata mata
programme.desc: Freek zoekt in de Amazone van Peru naar een schildpad die hij nog nooit in het wild heeft gezien: de mata mata, maar een gammel bruggetje gooit roet in het eten. Met hulp van een lokale taxichauffeur komt hij toch op de juiste plek. Freek laat zien hoe deze bizarre schildpad zich vermomt en nietsvermoedende visjes naar binnen zuigt.

programme.title: Ik ben de Faker
programme.desc: Twee bekende Zapp'ers nemen het tegen elkaar op in een spannend familiespel vol bedrog en ontmaskering. Binnen een gezin wordt één familielid vervangen door de Faker: een buitenstaander die zich zo geloofwaardig mogelijk moet voordoen als volwaardig gezinslid. Iedereen weet wie de Faker is, behalve de Detective. Die moet achterhalen wie er niet écht bij de familie hoort. De Coach verzint samen met het gezin Fakerstreken om de Detective in de val te lokken. Vanuit een bus volgen de Coach en het vervangend gezinslid live hoe de Detective er alles aan doet om de Faker te ontmaskeren. Lukt het de Faker om onontdekt te blijven?

programme.title: Het klokhuis
programme.desc: De nieuwe buurvrouw van Heleen ontdekt dat ze recht heeft op een grotere tuin, maar dat is slecht nieuws voor Heleen. Bram is in de ban van een influencer en Peggy probeert te helpen. Serah en Tirsa testen of appel helpt tegen een knoflookadem. Anas leert wat een echo is, en test uit op welke plekken je die het beste hoort. Huh?! Wat bedoelen ze precies met 'grenzen'?

programme.title: NOS Jeugdjournaal
programme.desc: Het laatste nieuws uit binnen- en buitenland en het weer, speciaal voor de jonge kijker. En op NPO 1 extra met gebarentaal.

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Waar vind je de echte liefde? Het First Dates restaurant opent voor de achtste keer haar deuren. Dit restaurant onderscheidt zich van andere eetgelegenheden omdat de gasten single zijn en op zoek naar de ware. De vrijgezellen komen uit het hele land en zijn van alle leeftijden. We zien singles die dromen van een geschikte partner. Leidt een eerste date tot een tweede? En wie vindt de perfecte match?

programme.title: Van Roosmalen & Groenteman
programme.desc: Met verwondering, lichte irritatie en een scherp oog voor de absurditeit van de mediawereld en het publieke debat nemen Marcel van Roosmalen en Gijs Groenteman de week door.

programme.title: Motorbendes
programme.desc: Klaas Otto viert de oprichting van No Surrender met een groot feest. De club wordt in één klap een zwaargewicht wanneer Hells Angels-oprichter Big Willem en kopstukken als Willem Holleeder zich aansluiten. Otto doet een boekje open over zijn abrupte vertrek bij Satudarah en Henk Kuipers maakt de overstap naar No Surrender om het noordelijke deel te gaan leiden. Maar de keiharde groei blijft niet onopgemerkt: politie en justitie kijken scherp mee en luisteren in het geheim af in het clubhuis van Kuipers, waar "bad standings" op de voet worden gevolgd.

programme.title: Draadstaal
programme.desc: Satirisch sketchprogramma waarin Jeroen van Koningsbrugge en Dennis van de Ven in de huid kruipen van onbekende Nederlanders. Ze geven een stem aan landgenoten die zich met een welhaast bovenmenselijke inspanning door de overdaad aan crises in Nederland en de wereld proberen te slaan. Met een B&B Vol Liefde, Fred en Ria, de bizarre wereld van de snackbar, de dronken pastoor en andere tijdloos actuele figuren.

programme.title: Reizen Waes
programme.desc: De reis die Tom Waes het meest zal bijblijven is die naar IJsland. In het dorpje Mjoifjördur wonen maar elf mensen. Het ligt ver weg van de bewoonde wereld in het noordoosten van het eiland. Door het barre IJslandse weer is het acht maanden per jaar afgesloten van de rest van het land. Na een helse tocht weet Tom het dorp te bereiken, maar hij komt al snel te weten dat het er helemaal niet goed gaat.

programme.title: Kind van een Gedetineerde
